title: Michael Penix: I'm dying to be out there, some goals I still have to achieve

sources.name: Pro Football Talk
sources.title: Michael Penix: I'm dying to be out there, some goals I still have to achieve
sources.description: The Falcons haven't named a starting quarterback for Sunday's game against the Panthers and Michael Penix didn't do much to suggest that he'll be the choice during his Wednesday press conference.
